release_notes: Ban 0.0.21: (1) O 'Ky nhanh' giu dung ten ky vua chon thay vi tu ve 'Ky nhanh...'; bam lai cung ky van ap dung; sua tay ngay thi o ky tu ve mac dinh de khong hien sai. Ap dung cho Hoa don mua ban, Bao cao va Goi y to khai. (2) Bo loc cu 'Moi tinh chat' doi thanh 'Nguon' dung du lieu that: Moi nguon / Dong bo cong thue / Nhap tu email — ba muc 'Thay the / Dieu chinh / Huy' truoc day khong co du lieu nen luon ra 0 dong, nay da bo; trang thai do loc o o 'Trang thai HD' theo ma cua cong thue.
